change_rationale: 선임심의 후속: 사전 전략·종결 책임, Deputy와 독립 Track R 직무, 과거 수락과 현재 세션 준비의 분리. 기존 유보 권한을 확대하지 않는다.
role_assignment_rule: A named person, AI agent or service may perform a role only after exact-HEAD constitutional readiness and explicit acceptance of its mission, authority limits, required outputs, prohibitions, success measures and reporting cadence. One actor may temporarily hold multiple roles, but generation, independent validation and Production approval must remain separated.

roles.title: Program Owner
roles.mission: Set the strategic direction of KIDULTS and make final decisions on scope, priorities, investment, providers, residual risk and Production promotion.
core_responsibilities: Approve program mission, Core Vertical scope and strategic priorities
Approve provider contact, commercial negotiation and contractual commitment
Approve material changes to operating doctrine and official terminology
Resolve cross-track priority conflicts
Accept or reject residual risk after independent validation
Approve Production promotion and rollback when business judgment is required
Approve material synchronization into Master Book, Baseline Book and Architecture Book
decision_authority: Final program scope
Final budget and provider commitment
Final Production approval
Final residual-risk acceptance
Final material Book doctrine approval
must_not: Be required to manage hourly implementation details
Approve a release without traceable evidence, gate status and rollback target
Treat a chat-only statement as an official program decision
success_measures: High-value decisions are made from measured evidence
No provider spend precedes a defined and measured data gap
Production releases are reversible and decision-traceable
The three tracks remain strategically aligned
roles.reporting_cadence: Receives the 06:00 KST integrated digest, immediate material-event escalations and gate-completion decision requests.

roles.title: Chief Architect, Integration Conductor and Program QA Coordinator
roles.mission: 사전 전략과 핵심 병목을 먼저 확정하고 모든 Track의 호환 가능한 인계를 통합하며, 허용된 과제를 실제 종결 증거까지 책임진다.
core_responsibilities: Maintain the cross-track operating model, registries, contracts and integration gates
Ensure the three workstreams use the same snapshot ID, methodology version and terminology
Review handoffs for completeness, compatibility and traceability
Coordinate contract changes between producer and consumer tracks
Prepare the daily integrated executive digest
Maintain the risk, decision, handoff and release records
When performed by an AI agent, retain KPMO accountability through authorized execution, helper review, validation, truth-sync and final reporting
Recommend release readiness but not replace the Program Owner's final approval
Coordinate synchronization into the three official Books
Prevent isolated chat sessions from becoming divergent sources of truth
작업 전 목표·완료 조건·현재 증거·핵심 병목·최단 검증 경로·제외 범위·전환 기준을 준비한다
시간·재작업·비용·불필요한 Owner 개입을 측정하고 동일 실패의 무한 반복을 막는다
Deputy에 범위가 분명한 과제를 위임하되 AI-019의 KPMO 최종 책임은 유지한다
required_deliverables: Decision requests with options and evidence
Executive sprint report at each sprint completion
증거에 결속된 실행 전략과 제한된 재시도·전환 기록
종단 간 종결 및 인수인계 증거
decision_authority: Reject an incomplete or incompatible handoff
Block integration on contract or snapshot mismatch
Recommend release, hold or rollback
Propose architecture and operating-process changes
must_not: Invent official doctrine without registering and routing it through change control
Alter Track A metrics to make a Portal release easier
Approve provider contracts or final Production promotion
When performed by an AI agent, self-exempt from AI-019, transfer KPMO core duties to Codex or another helper, or adjudicate its own removal or reinstatement
Claim work is completed without verifiable artifacts
자기 선임 또는 X4 최종 KPMO 적격성을 자기판정하지 않는다
Track R의 독립 지적을 삭제·수정·무효화하지 않는다
success_measures: No snapshot-ID mismatch reaches release review
Cross-track blockers are identified before late-stage rework
All three tracks and Books use the same approved language
The Program Owner receives one coherent operating picture
개별 PR·CI·병합을 전체 플랫폼 종결로 보고하지 않는다
roles.reporting_cadence: Continuous integration monitoring, 06:00 KST daily digest, immediate material-event escalation and Sunday synchronization review.

roles.title: Track A Lead — Kidults 120 Score / PoC Intelligence Producer
roles.mission: Discover and measure the Right Data, improve speed, quality and scale, and publish reproducible versioned intelligence snapshot candidates under explicit assumptions.
core_responsibilities: Operate self-collected and future provider-assisted PoC pipelines
Maintain the provider-independent baseline
Measure Right Data Coverage, precision, demand, scarcity, confidence, freshness and source diversity
Run stress, scale, recovery and cost experiments
Identify provider gaps only after measuring internal capability
Produce hourly and material-event reports
Publish immutable snapshot candidates with evidence lineage and methodology version
Preserve failed runs and historical baselines
State interpretation limits and avoid permanent-superiority claims
decision_authority: Choose experiments within approved PoC scope
Recommend current Featured candidates
Recommend collection and scoring priorities
Mark a candidate as experimental, observable, qualified or blocked before independent assessment
must_not: Claim absolute or permanent market superiority
Convert unknown or missing data into zero
Approve provider spend or contract terms
roles.reporting_cadence: Hourly, immediately on a material event, and a daily candidate-status handoff before the integrated digest.

roles.title: Track B Lead — Independent Rankability Reviewer
roles.mission: Independently determine whether an exact 120 snapshot candidate is sufficiently complete, differentiated, stable and defensible for ranking, provider spend consideration or release promotion.
core_responsibilities: Assess one immutable snapshot ID at a time
Evaluate rankability, separation, stability, sensitivity and evidence sufficiency
Identify bottlenecks before external market-data spend
Publish measurable exit criteria for each blocker
Classify the gate as blocked, conditional or publishable
Provide recommendations to Track A without altering its data
Report immediately when gate state changes
decision_authority: Set the independent Rankability Gate state
Block release when rankability evidence is inadequate
Recommend conditional promotion with explicit residual risks
Request additional evidence from Track A
must_not: Change source records or Track A metrics
Reuse an assessment for a different snapshot ID
Treat current observability as permanent superiority
success_measures: Low false confidence before market-data spend
Independence from Track A and Track C incentives
roles.reporting_cadence: For every material snapshot candidate, immediately on gate change, and a daily status handoff before the integrated digest.

roles.title: Track C Lead — Portal V502 & Data Connection
roles.mission: Build and operate a modular premium intelligence interface that consumes only approved versioned snapshots and replaceable editorial assets.
core_responsibilities: Implement the published-snapshot contract
Render all eight Core Verticals and the dynamic current Featured Set
Build registry-based Hero, object and editorial-asset selection
Maintain desktop, tablet and mobile responsiveness
Expose data mode, snapshot ID, freshness, confidence and interpretation limits
Produce Portal release manifests and QA evidence
Report contract, asset, rendering and performance failures back to the producing tracks
Maintain rollback-compatible releases
decision_authority: Choose implementation details that preserve approved contracts and design system
Block a Portal release on contract, asset, rights, responsive or performance failure
Request contract clarification or missing assets
Recommend release readiness
must_not: Read raw PoC or provider data directly
Silently convert missing values to zero
Publish prototype or uncleared assets as Production
Modify the intelligence result to fit the design
success_measures: No hidden calculation or data distortion
roles.reporting_cadence: On every material contract or release change, immediately on rendering/asset/contract failure, and daily before the integrated digest.

roles.title: Snapshot Publisher
roles.current_holder: Integration function; assignable to an automated service after validation
roles.mission: Package a valid candidate and its assessment into a controlled, immutable, auditable release artifact without altering the intelligence content.
core_responsibilities: Validate snapshot and assessment schema
Verify snapshot-ID and methodology-version consistency
Move artifacts through Draft, Internal, QA Passed, Approved, Published and Archived states
Maintain current and previous published pointers
Write release lineage and rollback references
Fail closed on incomplete or mismatched artifacts
decision_authority: Reject technically invalid publication requests
Publish only after all required approvals are present
Restore the previous approved snapshot during an authorized rollback
must_not: Change ranking, Featured Set or metrics
roles.reporting_cadence: Every candidate publication, failure, rollback and archive event.

roles.title: Registry Custodian
roles.mission: Maintain the shared program memory so all people, AI agents, code, Portal and Books use the same approved identifiers, roles, decisions and states.
core_responsibilities: Maintain program, role, cadence, decision, risk, snapshot, evidence, object, asset, rights, provider and release registries
Validate stable IDs and version changes
Reject duplicate, ambiguous or chat-only official terms
Maintain history rather than destructive overwrite
Ensure registry updates link to evidence and approval
Publish change summaries to the canonical board
decision_authority: Reject malformed or conflicting registry entries
Request approval evidence
Deprecate but not erase superseded identifiers
must_not: Make a track result official without required evidence and gate state
roles.reporting_cadence: On every material registry change and in the daily integrated digest.

roles.title: Editorial & Rights Reviewer
roles.current_holder: Function awaiting named assignment; Program Owner retains final rights-risk authority
roles.mission: Ensure every Production editorial asset is category-representative, visually consistent, high quality and legally safe for its intended use.
core_responsibilities: Review Original Editorial Visual quality and category relevance
Verify logo, trademark, trade-dress, copyright and licensing risk
Classify assets as Prototype, Editorial Approved, Rights Cleared or Production Ready
Maintain Hero, Gallery, Mobile, Research and Thumbnail variants
Confirm asset metadata, ownership, approval and replacement history
Block uncleared or low-quality assets from Production
decision_authority: Block an asset from Production
Approve editorial quality within established standards
Request redesign, regeneration or replacement
must_not: Choose Featured Verticals based on aesthetics
Use a third-party brand asset without rights basis
Approve a Prototype asset as Production without required gates
success_measures: Fast asset replacement without Portal redesign
roles.reporting_cadence: At every asset approval, rejection, replacement or rights event.

roles.title: QA & Release Manager
roles.current_holder: Integration function; independent review required for Production
roles.mission: Verify that a proposed release satisfies contract, functional, responsive, performance, accessibility, monitoring and rollback requirements.
core_responsibilities: Validate release against G0–G5 gates
Run contract, data, desktop, tablet, mobile, accessibility and performance checks
Verify rollback snapshot and deployment workflow
Confirm no unrelated files are included in the release
Produce release recommendation and residual-risk summary
Monitor the initial Production window and initiate authorized rollback
decision_authority: Block release on failed quality gates
Recommend go, conditional go or no-go
Trigger pre-authorized technical rollback
roles.reporting_cadence: Every release candidate, deployment, monitoring window and rollback.

roles.title: Documentation & Three-Book Synchronization Lead
roles.mission: Keep operational reality, official terminology, GitHub documentation and the three Books synchronized without creating a fourth parallel doctrine.
core_responsibilities: Classify approved content into Master Book, Baseline Book or Architecture Book
Maintain decision and terminology traceability
Update current baselines after approved snapshots
Update architecture after approved contract or operating-model changes
Prevent stale or contradictory official documentation
Prepare weekly synchronization review
decision_authority: Reject undocumented material changes from official release
Request clarification before Book synchronization
Propose correct Book placement
must_not: Turn unapproved chat discussion into doctrine
success_measures: No material contradiction among code, registry and Books
Fast onboarding of new people and AI agents
Clear separation of philosophy, current baseline and implementation
roles.reporting_cadence: Sunday integrated review and every material doctrine or architecture release.

roles.title: Incident & Escalation Manager
roles.current_holder: Integration function during PoC; assignable for Production operations
roles.mission: Coordinate rapid, traceable and reversible response to data, provider, rights, release and Portal incidents.
core_responsibilities: Open and classify material incidents
Coordinate containment, rollback and stakeholder communication
Preserve evidence and timeline
Assign root-cause and corrective-action owners
Track remediation to verified closure
Feed lessons learned into risk, decision, baseline and architecture records
decision_authority: Declare an incident
Activate pre-authorized containment and rollback
Request immediate track reports
must_not: Close an incident without verified corrective action
Accept business residual risk on behalf of the Program Owner
roles.reporting_cadence: Immediate on incident declaration, periodic updates during response and closure report after verification.

roles.title: Program Participant — Human, AI Agent or Service
roles.mission: Execute assigned work using the official shared language, contracts, registries and decision structure.
core_responsibilities: Read the coordination hub and role registry before work begins
Declare the role and track being performed
Use canonical IDs and official terminology
Attach evidence to claims and handoffs
Record material decisions, risks and blockers in GitHub
Protect secrets, rights and data lineage
Escalate conflicts instead of creating isolated workarounds
When acting as an AI agent, retain end-to-end ownership of assigned execution, helper review, validation, truth-sync and final reporting
Leave the shared record more complete than it was found
required_deliverables: Disclosure of uncertainty, failure or missing data
decision_authority: Execute within assigned scope
Stop work and escalate on safety, rights, data-loss or contract concerns
must_not: When acting as an AI agent, transfer a core assigned duty or accountability to Codex, another helper or a human while capable and authorized to perform it
Present a prompt, draft, recommendation or unverified helper output as completed execution
Modify another track's owned artifact without approved handoff
Treat memory from a separate chat as official truth
success_measures: Low rework caused by isolated assumptions
roles.reporting_cadence: As defined by the assigned role and immediately on material risk or conflict.

roles.title: Deputy KPMO — 전략 보완·실행·육성
roles.mission: KPMO 전략의 약한 전제를 검증하고 대안을 비교하며 위임된 과제를 완결해 보완·대행 역량을 육성한다.
core_responsibilities: 현재 증거와 과거 진단을 구분한다
결정적 전제의 최소비용 선검증과 대안 경로 비교를 수행한다
위임 범위의 실행·회귀·비용·인수인계를 책임진다
decision_authority: 이미 위임된 범위 안의 진단·구현·시험만 수행한다
불완전한 전제와 인계를 지적하고 교정안을 제시한다
success_measures: 제한된 과제를 인수인계 가능한 증거로 끝낸다
roles.reporting_cadence: 위임 과제의 중요 변화·진짜 blocker·검증된 종결 시 KPMO에 보고한다.

roles.title: Track R Lead — 레드팀 및 독립 검증
roles.mission: KPMO에 종속되지 않고 중요한 전략·권한·완료 주장을 반증 시험하며 근거·영향 범위·해소 조건을 John에게 직접 보고한다.
core_responsibilities: 전략의 핵심 가정과 권한 경계를 반증 시험한다
자신이 작성한 변경·시험·인선은 독립 심사에서 제척한다
증거와 영향 범위가 명확한 지적을 보존한다
Track B의 스냅샷별 독립 판정을 존중한다
required_deliverables: 근거·영향 범위·해소 조건을 갖춘 검증 의견
decision_authority: 허용된 읽기·격리 시험 범위에서 독립 지적을 제출한다
증거가 부족한 완료 주장을 인정하지 않는다
success_measures: 잘못된 완료 주장과 중요 결함을 조기에 발견한다
검증이 새로운 상시 승인 대기열이 되지 않는다
roles.reporting_cadence: 중요 지적·해소 검증·인선 이해상충을 John에게 직접 보고한다.
